parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The client generates the value of this parameter. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length. > If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance.
